title: Ordinary Hecke Specht Polytabloids and Signed Murphy Comparison

items.title: Hecke row permutation modules and ordinary Dipper–James polytabloids
items.statement: Let A=Z[v,v^{-1}] and H=H_v(S_n), (T_i-v)(T_i+1)=0. Use right modules and star(T_w)=T_{w^{-1}}. For a partition lambda set x_lambda=sum_{w in rowYoung(lambda)}T_w and y_lambda=sum_{w in rowYoung(lambda)}(-v)^{-ell(w)}T_w. Define M(lambda)=x_lambda H, with row-standard distinguished-coset vectors x_lambda T_d. Fix row-filled t^lambda and column-filled t_lambda; let w_lambda send t^lambda to t_lambda under the right permutation action. The ordinary DJ polytabloid generator is z_lambda=x_lambda T_{w_lambda}y_{lambda'}, and P(lambda)=z_lambda H inside M(lambda). Define the permutation form by beta(x_lambda T_d,x_lambda T_e)=delta_{d,e}v^{ell(d)} and the standard DJ form as its restriction to P(lambda). Specify empty-shape conventions x=y=z=1. Over a commutative ring R with unit q, define all objects by A→R,v→q; subsequent suppliers must prove freeness, the polytabloid presentation and compatibility with this actual submodule realization.
items.strategy: BUILD TARGET, NOT A SUPPLIED PROOF. Verify coset orientations, length factors and eigenvalues against the concrete DJ construction before scaffolding. Do not DEFINE P(lambda) to be a Murphycell twist; the historical polytabloid submodule/form is the independent side of the required comparison. Prove the permutation-module basis and action directly from standard Hecke multiplication. If the actual cited DJ presentation uses a different canonical w or unit normalization, give the explicit change and update this draft before acceptance; do not silently assume it.

items.title: The Hecke sign automorphism, pullback and contragredient dual
items.statement: For every R and unit q, theta(T_i)=-q T_i^{-1}=(q-1)-T_i defines an involutive R-algebra automorphism commuting with star. Right-module pullback M^theta has action m*h=m theta(h); the star-contragredient is M^circ=Hom_R(M,R) with (f*h)(m)=f(m h^star). Pullback is exact, preserves submodules, quotients, finite composition multiplicities and simplicity, and commutes with finite-free star-dual and arbitrary base change. At q=1 it is tensoring with sign. theta(x_lambda)=q^{ell(w0_lambda)} y_lambda; this unit factor must be carried through every form comparison.
items.strategy: BUILD TARGET, NOT A SUPPLIED PROOF. Check quadratic and braid relations via generator inverses; check the x/y identity by pairing w with w0_lambda and exact lengths, without division by quantumfactorials. This elementary lemma does not establish Specht duality.

items.title: Integral Murphy and polytabloid straightening for the comparison
items.statement: Over A, set m_st=T_{d(s)}^star x_lambda T_{d(t)} for standard tableaux s,t of shape lambda. These form a cellular basis with higher dominance ideals I^{>lambda}, fixed-first-index multiplication coefficients and star swapping indices. C_M(lambda)=(x_lambda H+I^{>lambda})/I^{>lambda} is free on m_t=x_lambda T_{d(t)}+I^{>lambda}. Independently, ordinary P(lambda) has a finite standard q-polytabloid basis of cardinal f^lambda, with a split integral inclusion in M(lambda). Establish the exact Garnir relations, all leading unit coefficients, and simultaneous base-change compatibility for both constructions. Define the Murphy form G_lambda by m_us m_tv≡G_lambda(s,t)m_uv mod I^{>lambda}; prove well-definedness, symmetry, star-associativity and finite Gram-kernel submodule property.
items.strategy: BUILD TARGET, NOT A SUPPLIED PROOF. Supply the actual complete integral Garnir proof on BOTH sides. Reuse only published Hecke standard basis and tableau foundations; source20 Murphy/cell prototypes are forbidden dependencies. A generic semisimple rank count cannot prove the integral split inclusion, dominance ideals or singular-parameter basis. This is the main finite straightening prerequisite.

items.title: Murphy cells are the same-shape contragredient Specht duals
items.statement: For every commutative R, unit q and partition lambda there is an explicit perfect R-bilinear star-balanced pairing C_M(lambda)×P(lambda)→R, giving C_M(lambda)≅P(lambda)^circ naturally under all coefficient-ring base changes. Equivalently identify the kernel of the row-permutation quotient onto C_M(lambda) with the orthogonal complement of P(lambda), using the independently defined permutation form. The pairing matrix on actual standard bases has determinant a unit in A; its entries and inverse must be given by finite tableau formulas. No nondegeneracy of the form restricted to P(lambda) is required.
items.strategy: BUILD TARGET, NOT A SUPPLIED PROOF. Prove kernel equality integrally and a unit determinant, or an explicit inverse, not merely equal dimensions over Q(v). Distinguish the perfect cross-pairing from either module self-form. The source statements alone do not provide this proof.

items.title: Ordinary Specht modules and forms match signed conjugate Murphy cells
items.statement: For every commutative R, unit q and partition lambda, construct a base-change compatible isomorphism Phi_lambda:P(lambda)→C_M(lambda')^theta. Determine an explicit unit u_lambda(v)∈A^times such that G_{lambda'}(Phi_lambda x,Phi_lambda y)=u_lambda(q) beta_DJ(x,y), for all x,y. Prove the unit and formula in the fixed generator/form normalizations; no unnamed scalar or scalar that may vanish is permitted. Consequently the form radicals and their quotients correspond after every field specialization: D_DJ^lambda≅(D_M^{lambda'})^theta, including zero quotients. Over a PID with a chosen prime, the unit-scaled form identity preserves all Jantzen divisibility submodules and reductions. Also derive P(lambda')≅P(lambda)^circ,theta with the exact position of dual and theta, thereby separating same-shape duality from conjugate-sign transport.
items.strategy: BUILD TARGET, NOT A SUPPLIED PROOF. Supply signed row/column pairing or complete Murphy1995Thm5.2 proof with explicit maps. Compare actual self-forms, not just the abstract modules. COMPUTE u_lambda, do not guess it. theta(x_lambda) carries a quantum-power unit from the preceding lemma. Nonzero form is not equivalent to nonsingular form. If a proposed identity is invalid in these fixed normalizations, expose the precise obstruction before changing claims; root must retain original ordinary-presentation applicability.

items.title: Polytabloid specialization and the exact signed multiplicity dictionary
items.statement: For every field F at q=1, P(lambda) specializes to the ordinary integral-polytabloid Specht module F⊗S_Z^lambda, with its standard form, and theta becomes sign tensoring. For arbitrary unit q over a field, [P(lambda):D_DJ^mu]=[C_M(lambda'):D_M^{mu'}] whenever D_M^{mu'} is nonzero. For a Schur corner already proved to send W(lambda) to C_M(lambda) and L(lambda) to D_M(lambda), the ordinary dictionary is F(W(lambda'))≅P(lambda)^theta and F(L(lambda'))≅(D_DJ^lambda)^theta, including zero; it is never the untwisted conjugate-dual identity. The simultaneous-twist multiplicities agree. No Schur algebra or source20 convention result is a prerequisite for this conditional dictionary.
items.strategy: BUILD TARGET, NOT A SUPPLIED PROOF. At q1 show each concrete q-polytabloid and permutation form specializes to its integral tabloid counterpart; no complex-only standard-polytabloid theorem is extended to arbitraryfields. Multiplicity equality follows by the exact theta pullback. Schur assertions are conditional applications of the proved bridge, not a backward dependency on source20.
